mechanisms_compared.assessment: Use a separate SmartRecruiters fetch script and manually normalize its output into Helix. Rejected because it preserves operator friction and another sidecar lifecycle.

Replace the proven explicit provider dispatcher with a generalized plugin framework. Rejected because it increases regression surface and displaces working Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby contracts without a measured benefit.

Selected: implement a provider-native SmartRecruiters parser with list pagination plus detail-bound job-ad retrieval, then compose it behind the existing TargetOpeningSource dispatcher so the unchanged downstream Opening Watch and target intelligence/application architecture inherits the new reach.
